facts.business: Banco Products (India) Limited manufactures and sells automotive components, recognizing revenue when control of goods is transferred to customers across domestic and export markets.
key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity due to variable consideration (rebates, discounts), incoterms, and timing of transfer of control
Inventory existence and valuation risk given high inventory levels (Rs 27,927.76 lakhs, 22.74% of total assets) across multiple factory locations
facts.related_party_note: CSR contribution to a trust controlled by the company (no amount disclosed for FY 2025-26 or FY 2024-25)
